disposition_reason: ED-16 forbids guessing an injection target. Generic CE evidence and the documented defective logged address cannot prove the primary mirror side; PASS requires precomputed TAD/sa2da mapping, exact masks and controller-local MSCOD0x80 under approved recovery.
decision_basis: Read XLSX row164 and history2548; unique identity retained.

test_case.test_name: GNR Full-Mirror primary-side CE with MSCOD0x80
test_case.purpose: Prove one CE in a mapped primary-side mirrored row reaches the intended IMC and correctable-read decoder while mirror health remains intact.
required_package: Approved Intel CScripts/FAE and version-specific defect notes
POR or approved non-POR DIMM/mirror topology
Mirror bit, half-capacity, TAD/sa2da primary-side map
Exact memDevs masks and MSCOD0x80 oracle
Dedicated SUT, serial/OOB recovery and settings rollback
test_case.test_command: Qualified operator preserves baseline, verifies mirror/capacity/TAD invariants and maps0x100000000 to the primary MC/DIMM, applies the literal masks, performs one CE, decodes the target IMC/MSCOD0x80 without trusting the defective address field, executes go once, verifies health and restores settings.
test_case.expected_result: One mapped primary-side CE reports the approved correctable-read state and MSCOD0x80 on the intended IMC, mirror topology remains healthy, resume succeeds and all temporary settings are restored.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires immutable topology/map/mask/harness identity, one CE, target-local MSCOD0x80, healthy mirror/resume and restoration. Wrong side/IMC/severity, reliance on bad address, missing evidence or recovery failure fails/blocks.
safety_gate: Explicit critical injection authorization on an isolated SUT.
Do not proceed if half-capacity/TAD/primary mapping is inconsistent.
Preserve prior logs; never blanket-clear or infer target from defective address.
One injection/go only; no automatic retry or cold boot.
expected_evidence: Mirror bit, capacity, channels and TAD/sa2da mapping
Exact masks and single CE transcript
Target IMC/manual MSCOD0x80 decode with defect note
test_case.recovery: On wrong IMC/severity, mirror degradation or hang, preserve evidence and use approved OOB recovery without reinjection; restore mirror/debug settings and validate memory topology plus OS/BMC health.
